description: Behavior-preserving extraction of the non-trivial, high-bug-risk hook logic into pure, dependency-free helpers in src/lib/, then unit-test the helpers. The hooks cannot be imported in node tests because they pull in firebase/expo/AsyncStorage, so the logic must be extracted first. Covers usePomodoro phase transitions, useProgress analytics/selectors, and useAuth error mapping. Every extraction moves the EXISTING expression verbatim into a function and re-imports it into the hook so runtime behavior is unchanged; the full-suite green run after each extraction is the guard. Do NOT touch Firestore/AsyncStorage I/O code paths, do NOT change the Vitest environment, do NOT use renderHook. Independent of FEAT-001 but should run after it so the final diff builds on a clean test base.
steps: Extract Pomodoro logic into src/lib/pomodoro.ts: computeNextPhase(state, durations) returning { mode, timeLeft, completedSessions, timerAlert } that mirrors EXACTLY the timer-completion effect branches in src/hooks/usePomodoro.ts (work -> break normally, work -> longBreak when newSessions % SESSIONS_BEFORE_LONG_BREAK === 0 with 'longBreakEarned'/'workDone' alerts; break|longBreak -> work with 'breakDone'); computeSkip(mode, durations); computeProgress(mode, timeLeft, durations) matching ((totalSeconds - timeLeft) / totalSeconds) * 100; and a pure formatTime(seconds) matching the existing mm:ss pad. Export SESSIONS_BEFORE_LONG_BREAK. Re-wire usePomodoro to import and call these helpers so behavior is identical.

Create src/hooks/__tests__/pomodoro.test.ts importing from '@/src/lib/pomodoro'. Cover: work->break increments session with 'workDone'; the SESSIONS_BEFORE_LONG_BREAK-th session -> longBreak with 'longBreakEarned'; break->work resets to workMinutes*60 with 'breakDone'; longBreak->work; computeSkip work->break and break->work; computeProgress at start (0), midpoint, end (100); custom durations respected; formatTime(0)='00:00', formatTime(65)='01:05', formatTime(3600)='60:00'.

Extract useProgress analytics into src/lib/progressStats.ts as pure functions taking tasks (+ goals/today where needed) as args, moving the memo/callback bodies verbatim: computeStreak(tasks, today), computeTimeTrackingStats(tasks), computeBestHours(tasks), computeTopicBalance(tasks), computeProductivityScore(tasks, goals, today), computeDailyGoalProgress(tasks, goals, today), computeExtraGoalsProgress(todayTasks, goals), computeWeeklyReport(tasks, now, weeksAgo), computeChartData(tasks, today, days), plus predicates shouldCreateRecurringTask(task, dateStr), getPrioritySortValue(p), sortTasksByPriority(list), areDependenciesMet(task, tasks). Keep 'today'/'now' injectable for determinism. Re-wire useProgress useMemo/useCallback blocks to delegate to these helpers with identical output. Leave all Firestore/AsyncStorage code untouched.

Create src/hooks/__tests__/progressStats.test.ts importing from '@/src/lib/progressStats' with fixed task fixtures and an injected today. Cover: streak empty->0, single day->current/best 1, consecutive run, broken run (current resets, best preserved), studiedToday true/false; productivity score level thresholds at 20/40/60/80 and streak cap at 40; time-tracking accurate within +-10% vs over/under classification and empty->zeros with no divide-by-zero; best-hours period buckets (morning 6-12, afternoon 12-18, evening 18-24, night 0-6) and peak ordering; topic balance percent sums, dominant >50% and neglected <10% suggestions; shouldCreateRecurringTask for daily/weekly/weekdays/custom/none; priority sort ordering (high<medium<low<none, dueTime tiebreak); areDependenciesMet true when all deps complete, false otherwise; weekly report Monday-start window and chart-data length === days.

Extract useAuth error mapping into src/lib/authErrors.ts: move mapFirebaseError(code) and extractErrorMessage(err) verbatim, export both, and import them back into src/hooks/useAuth.ts. Create src/lib/__tests__/authErrors.test.ts covering every mapped auth/* code, the default branch for an unknown code, and extractErrorMessage for a {code} object, an Error instance, and an arbitrary non-error value. Do not mock Firebase or test I/O callbacks.
Run the full suite and confirm no regressions across all files.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/pomodoro.ts, src/lib/progressStats.ts, src/lib/authErrors.ts exist and are imported/used by their respective hooks (usePomodoro, useProgress, useAuth) with no runtime behavior change.
`npx vitest --run` full suite is green (exit code 0), including FEAT-001's files and all pre-existing tests.
findings: New helpers: src/lib/pomodoro.ts (computeNextPhase/computeSkip/computeProgress/formatTime + SESSIONS_BEFORE_LONG_BREAK), src/lib/progressStats.ts (computeStreak/computeTimeTrackingStats/computeBestHours/computeTopicBalance/computeProductivityScore/computeDailyGoalProgress/computeExtraGoalsProgress/computeWeeklyReport/computeChartData + addDays/shouldCreateRecurringTask/getPrioritySortValue/sortTasksByPriority/areDependenciesMet), src/lib/authErrors.ts (mapFirebaseError/extractErrorMessage). Hooks re-wired: usePomodoro, useProgress, useAuth now import and delegate to these helpers with identical runtime behavior. Tests added: src/hooks/__tests__/pomodoro.test.ts, src/hooks/__tests__/progressStats.test.ts, src/lib/__tests__/authErrors.test.ts. Gotchas: (1) computeProductivityScore takes streakCurrent + overallPercent as args (both derived in the hook from streakData/task totals) to stay pure while preserving the exact formula; it reads only goals.dailyTaskTarget. (2) computeStreak/computeChartData take 'today' and computeWeeklyReport takes 'now' as injected params for determinism; the hook passes getToday()/new Date() so behavior is unchanged. (3) useProgress kept its local getToday()/addDays()/shouldCreateRecurringTask() as thin wrappers delegating to progressStats so the recurring-task effect is untouched; getDayOfWeek moved entirely into progressStats. (4) Pre-existing tsc errors in app/auth.tsx (dynamic import / module flag) are unrelated to this task and were not touched. Full suite: 11 files / 130 tests passing (exit 0).
